name: Palo Brunch Creamy White Celery Soup with Spiced Ciabatta Croutons
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Puréed and strained through a fine chinois so tough celery strings are removed, leaving a velvety cream soup, though celery root/stalk polyols (mannitol) remain.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy in remission with a Lactaid enzyme; skip if celery mannitol triggers FODMAP gas.
watchOuts: Mannitol polyols in concentrated celery purée
